subject: Panel fill: candidate Alex Jordan — interviewer equity & backfill plan
messages:
From: Rebecca Nguyen <rebecca@talentpartners.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final loop for Alex Jordan — week of May 10 — need panel coverage

Hi team,

Alex Jordan (SWE candidate, strong backend + systems) is progressing to the final onsite loop. Client wants this in the week of May 10; Alex listed solid availability across Tue–Thu.

Quick asks:
- Can you confirm who can take System Design (60m), Coding (50m), and Culture/Bar-raise (45m)?
- We noticed Markus is on the schedule for System Design but he flagged high calendar load for that week; if that's still risky, can we nominate a backfill?

Attached: Alex's resume and a simple interviewer availability matrix (please update).

Proposed (rough):
- System Design — Markus Klein (60m)
- Coding — Olga Petrov (50m)
- Culture / Leadership — Laura Bennett (45m)

If any of you want to swap, suggest alternate names/times and I’ll hold the candidate windows. We aim to lock the calendar by EOD Friday.

Thanks — Rebecca

Rebecca Nguyen
Senior Recruiting Partner | TalentPartners
rebecca@talentpartners.com
Attachment: alex-jordan-resume.pdf (PDF, 220KB)
Attachment: interviewer-availability-matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Rebecca Nguyen <rebecca@talentpartners.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final loop for Alex Jordan — week of May 10 — need panel coverage

Thanks Rebecca — quick read and a couple notes. I can take Coding but I want to rebalance the System Design slot. Markus is traveling to a client the week prior and has a couple of long offsite days during the loop window; I don't think he can reliably do a 60m deep design slot and give good feedback.

Suggestion: move Markus off System Design and move a senior IC (Monica Patel) into SD. Monica has led a lot of recent distributed systems interviews and can cover culture if we need to adjust. Markus could take a 30m prep/async feedback slot instead — he can do a short sync on May 9 (30m) to calibrate on the prompt and scoring.

If that's agreeable, Rebecca can you tentatively hold the System Design slot for Monica (Tues–Thurs windows) and I'll update the availability matrix. Laura — any preference on Culture vs leadership mix (45m) for your slot?

Thanks,
Olga

Olga Petrov
Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Rebecca Nguyen <rebecca@talentpartners.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final loop for Alex Jordan — week of May 10 — need panel coverage

On Wed, Apr 28, 2027 at 10:03 AM Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Rebecca — quick read and a couple notes. I can take Coding but I want to rebalance the System Design slot. Markus is traveling ...

Agree with Olga's call to rebalance. I can keep the Culture/Leadership slot but would prefer to emphasize cross-team collaboration and product-sense in my questions (45m). If Monica will take System Design, that works well.

Availability notes: I prefer Tuesday (May 11) late morning or Wednesday (May 12) early afternoon. If the candidate prefers Thursday, happy to shift but please flag in the matrix.

I'll also add a short 15m calibration note on the loop doc so folks know the scoring rubric I'm defaulting to.

—Laura

Laura Bennett
Director, Product Management
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Rebecca Nguyen <rebecca@talentpartners.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final loop for Alex Jordan — week of May 10 — need panel coverage

Thanks for looping me in — sorry for the late reply. I'm indeed on a travel block May 8–13 for a partner workshop; my in-person capacity is essentially zero that week. I shouldn't be the primary SD interviewer.

Happy to do the May 9 calibration call (30m) and review async notes if Monica covers SD. Monica is a great choice — she led the last disagg service interview and has the depth.

Action: I've updated my calendar to indicate 'no interviewing' May 8–13. Monica, if you can accept the tentative SD hold and confirm preferred times that'd be great.

-Markus

Markus Klein
Staff Engineer, Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Rebecca Nguyen <rebecca@talentpartners.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final loop for Alex Jordan — week of May 10 — need panel coverage

Confirming final plan and next steps so we can lock the calendar: 

Finalized panel (per availability):
- System Design (60m): Monica Patel — target Tue May 11, 11:00–12:00 PT (Rebecca: please tentatively hold)
- Coding (50m): Olga Petrov — target Tue May 11, 14:00–14:50 PT
- Culture / Leadership (45m): Laura Bennett — target Wed May 12, 13:00–13:45 PT

Markus: you'll run a 30m calibration call with Monica and me on May 9 at 10:00 PT to align prompts/scoring. You will handle async review of notes if travel interferes.

Rebecca: please send calendar invites to Alex and include the attached resume and the loop doc. Monica — can you accept the SD tentative hold and update the availability spreadsheet with your preferred alternate times (I put two more windows in the sheet).

Attachments: alex-jordan-resume.pdf; interviewer-availability-matrix.xlsx
Links: https://company-drive/redwood/hiring/AVAILABILITY-2027-Q2 (matrix), hiring loop doc internal (I added calibration bullet)

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick sync to keep candidate momentum. If anything changes I'll flag immediately.

Olga Petrov
Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
